text:
anya-partnerships: Quick sync — we need to lock the marketplace governance + field ops checklist for the Snowflake+Databricks+Qdrant bundle before the partner dry run next Tues. Who can own the checklist and embargo window?

sam-engineering: I can own infra checklist (package ids, docker tags, runtime perf smoke). Need final SKUs by EOD Wed.

lucy-gtm: I’ll handle announcement cadence + partner comms. Question: do we want a soft-announce to our field teams 48h before public listing?

anya-partnerships: Yes, soft-announce to field 48h prior. @rachel-fieldops please confirm readiness window for on-site demos.

rachel-fieldops: 48h works if we get the staging creds + sample dataset by Thu morning. Also need a runbook for rollback.

devon-legal: Reminder — we have a co-marketing asset approval process. Please attach drafts to the shared drive and tag me. We need copyright/partner logos cleared at least 72h before public listing.

sam-engineering: pushing the staging bundle to marketplace-staging now. Deploy log: ``deploy --bundle snow-db-dbx-qdrant --env staging --tag v1.0.0-rc``. Will post permalink when done.

marketplace-bot: staging package uploaded: https://marketplace.staging/redwood/bundles/snow-db-dbx-qdrant/v1.0.0-rc

lucy-gtm: Great. For cadence: internal dry run Tue -> partner dry run Thu -> public listing Fri. That gives 24h buffer for final signoffs. Thoughts?

anya-partnerships: timeline OK but legal needs 72h for assets, so either move public listing to Mon or get assets in by Fri morning. @devon-legal can you confirm earliest possible?

devon-legal: If partners respond same day, we can pull approvals by Mon. Realistically: assets by Fri AM -> approvals by Mon. If you need Fri listing, we need explicit written partner waiver.

rachel-fieldops: Also flagging hardware packaging: partner wants the quickstart USB image in the bundle. Who can check SHA checksums?

sam-engineering: I’ll generate checksums and embed them in the manifest. Example manifest snippet: ```{
  "bundle": "snow-db-dbx-qdrant",
  "artifacts": ["image-usb-v1.2.img", "connector-jar-0.9.1.jar"],
  "checksums": {"image-usb-v1.2.img": "sha256:...", "connector-jar-0.9.1.jar": "sha256:..."}
}```

lucy-gtm: Action items recap: 1) @sam-engineering - finalize SKUs + checksums by Wed EOD. 2) @rachel-fieldops - confirm demo creds + rollback runbook by Thu AM. 3) @devon-legal - review co-marketing assets, aim for Mon approval unless waiver. 4) @anya-partnerships & @lucy-gtm - coordinate partner comms and internal soft-announce.

anya-partnerships: Added — I'll send a short checklist doc after this thread and tag everyone. Also: let's include a tiny A/B note for the listing copy: call out "dedicated connector" vs "sidecar ingest" so customers know deployment options.

marketplace-bot: reminder: marketplace listing requires: product page, pricing tiers, support contacts, security attestation blob, image/video link. See /docs/marketplace/requirements

sam-engineering: noted. I'll upload the security attestation to the staging page and add support email.

lucy-gtm: One more: partner asked for embargoed press kit. @devon-legal is the NDA we have sufficient for embargo?

devon-legal: Our standard partner embargo clause covers this but we need explicit dates in the NDA addendum. Send me proposed embargo dates and we’ll patch the addendum.

anya-partnerships: Proposed dates: partner dry run Thu (4/10), internal soft-announce Sat (4/12), public listing Mon (4/14). Devon, can you add those to the addendum?

devon-legal: Yes, will draft and circulate by Fri noon.

rachel-fieldops: Also flagging telemetry: please include a lightweight debug toggle in the connector so field engineers can enable verbose logs during demos.

sam-engineering: adding `DEBUG=1` toggle and a short `logs.md` -> will push to staging.

anya-partnerships: Perfect. If no objections, I'll create the checklist doc and schedule a 20-min alignment call tomorrow at 10am to walk through gaps.

lucy-gtm: +1 for the call.

devon-legal: +1.

rachel-fieldops: +1.

sam-engineering: +1.

anya-partnerships: OK creating calendar invite now. Thanks everyone — tagging thread "marketplace-governance-fieldops-sync" for followups.
